title: Bug 660000: [64bit] Overflow in item application entry
summary: Some variables in the Item Application Entry table were declared as Integer instead of BigInteger. This happened because a cost calculation optimization crossed the switch to 64-bit integers. They are now BigInteger, which prevents overflow errors.
key_points: A cost calculation optimization crossed the move to 64-bit integers and left some variables as Integer
Those variables in table 339 Item Application Entry now use BigInteger
Changed in both the W1 and RU layers
Prevents overflow errors in item application entry processing
quote: Some variables were declared as int instead of bigint.
